activity_summary: My lord of Southampton called from Holborn, where he is for two nights, with Florio frowning at his elbow. He called poems left for players a desertion. You told him the players pay by the week, and that you do not forget his honour. He is to run at the tilt, and he asked you to come and see him unhorsed. The court is certain he is in love. He asked for fourteen lines to send with a pair of gloves, for a lady he did not name. She mocks him. You told him of the friar. Florio's horse would not wait. You gave no verse, and you promised none.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood, answered, and did not promise a line.

entities.name: Henry Wriothesley, 3rd Earl of Southampton
entities.context: Named himself and Holborn, asked for the fourteen lines, and commended him.

entities.name: John Florio
entities.context: At his elbow, frowning, and then a horse off the stair. He was not a third voice in the talk.

quotes.text: The players pay by the week, my lord.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: My lord, I have a friar who bids his lovers love moderately.
